title: Clawd X Digest
summary: OpenAI API Upgrades: OpenAI published a massive changelog detailing the launch of GPT-5.5, GPT-5.4, and the new Agents SDK.
AI Benchmarks & Valuation: GLM-5.2 scored 77.0% on ARC-AGI, matching low-reasoning GPT-5.5 performance, while Figma's post-IPO stock slump sparks debate on AI design threats.
Macro & Semiconductor Trends: China's CXMT sees intense talent competition ahead of its expected 2 trillion RMB IPO, while discussions arise over the SEC's proposed reporting frequency changes.

Sports & Culture: Julian Nagelsmann criticizes the World Cup bracket layout, a spiritualist claims to lift a curse on Harry Kane, and social trends in Shanghai show young people opting out of traditional milestones.

items.title: @OpenAIDevs: OpenAI Releases Massive API Changelog
items.body: OpenAI published a major update to its API changelog, introducing GPT-5.5, GPT-5.4 mini/nano, new GPT-Realtime models, and developer blocks including the Agents SDK harness.

items.title: @cremieuxrecueil: Continuous GPT 5.5 Job Completed
items.body: A user reports successfully completing a long-running research job that required 16 days of continuous processing utilizing GPT 5.5 xhigh.

items.title: @arcprize: GLM-5.2 ARC-AGI Performance Results
items.body: ARC-AGI benchmarking results for GLM-5.2 show 77.0% on ARC-AGI-1, placing it on par with GPT-5.4 and GPT-5.5 in low-reasoning modes.

items.title: @ansonlin: Figma Stock Valuation Debate
items.body: The stock valuation of Figma is questioned after falling 85% post-IPO despite hitting revenue targets, with debate focusing on the actual threat of AI design tools like Claude.

items.title: @thdxr: Measuring Vibe Coding in Codebases
items.body: A humorous take on measuring 'vibe coding' codebase health by counting specific occurrences of type-checking overrides.

items.title: @GeminiApp: Gemini 3.5 Flash Travel Strategy
items.body: Google highlights Gemini 3.5 Flash's integration capabilities with Gmail and Calendar to automatically generate jet lag sleep plans.

items.title: @CryptoDoggyCN: CXMT Massive Recruitment and IPO
items.body: Recruitment at China's memory chipmaker CXMT (长鑫存储) is extremely competitive, with an upcoming July IPO expected to value the firm at 2 trillion RMB.

items.title: @keepitquarterly: SEC Reporting Frequency Debate
items.body: Criticisms mount against SEC Chair Atkins' support of semiannual financial reporting, with critics arguing it reduces investor protection.

items.title: @APompliano: Shifting Federal Reserve Policy
items.body: Pomp discusses the macro economic outlook, potential new leadership candidates like Kevin Warsh, and shifting policy directions at the Federal Reserve.

items.title: @dabowagaga: Venezuela Earthquake Evacuation Footage
items.body: Dramatic footage emerges of the earthquake shaking Venezuela, showing a resident evacuating a high-rise building during the tremors.

items.title: @MinMin89485072: Japan Initiates Response Measures
items.body: Reports surface regarding Japan's first round of economic or diplomatic countermeasures in response to recent geopolitical friction.

items.title: @iMiaSanMia: Harry Kane Spiritual Curse Lifted
items.body: Ghanaian spiritualist Nana Kwaku Bonsam claims to have lifted his curse on Harry Kane, wishing the striker well for his next matches.

items.title: @goalsside: Nagelsmann Criticizes World Cup Schedule
items.body: Germany's manager Julian Nagelsmann expresses frustration with the FIFA World Cup 2026 scheduling, claiming they face a tougher path for winning their group.

items.title: @wjf110: Shanghai Demographics and Marriage Trends
items.body: A viral discussion centers on Shanghai's high cost of living and changing social attitudes leading to declining marriage and birth rates among young professionals.

items.body: Practical advice for female students looking to enter manufacturing, highlighting PLC (programmable logic controller) engineering as a high-paying, accessible field.
